skills.description: Finds and lists all exported TypeScript interfaces in the project by scanning source files for `export interface` declarations, printing the file path, interface name, and line number.
Retrofits an existing repo with // @archNodeId: <id> header comments based on an ArchGraph JSON produced by scan-repo.
Creates a module scaffold on disk (directory or file) and ensures the // @archNodeId header is present in the entry file.
